'''Lobster Bisellian''' was an expensive meal. It was one of the house specialities of the [[Imperial (restaurant)|Imperial]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] and cost more than two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
